integrity: Analytical proof of high-frequency error, torus-phase criterion, and sharp dimension-three example. Supplementary finite checks do not replace proof. Scholarly priority not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two pairwise disjoint Euclidean balls; fixed d>=2 and fixed geometry. No uniform-in-geometry cutoff, no statement for connected domains, and no claim of optimal exponent for arbitrary domains. Full text of the recent motivating paper was unavailable for direct inspection.
title: Arithmetic lower envelopes of the spherical Fourier energy of two separated balls
